mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Annualized CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing S&P 500 underperformance in the next 20 trading days through reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad demand contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%) trigger policy easing expectations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
